v1.0.note: Global folders visible to every user no longer exist. Since v3.4 a folder is private or shared with your organisation, and only built-in platform content is visible to everyone. A chat's folder scope is no longer fixed at creation: since v4.4 you can change it mid-conversation.

v2.0.note: Global skills visible to every user became sharing within your organisation in v3.4. Skills are no longer overwritten on save: since v3.2 every save creates an immutable version.

v2.3.note: Library Health is no longer its own page. Since v3.9 it is the Health tab of the Library.

v2.9.note: The publish check has ten stages today, not eight: Grounding and a final Commit check were added later. The read-only flow graph was replaced by a drag-and-drop canvas in v3.6.

v3.0.note: Users can no longer share saved views, classification rules or custom fields with everyone: since v3.4 only platform-seeded content is shared that widely. The separate governance health page was folded into the Library's Health tab in v3.9.

v3.6.note: The visual canvas is no longer off by default. Since v3.9 it is on for everyone, and an operator can still switch it off.

v4.0.note: The scheduled watch loop that reads a connected folder every N minutes ships switched off. An operator has to turn on the watch process before a watched folder is read on a schedule.

v4.3.note: A restricted Expert no longer takes tools away. Since v4.4 an Expert only adds tools, skills and connections; restricted now limits which knowledge folders the Expert reads. An Expert's sample documents are now copied into each organisation that installs it.
